title: Ocean Point Villa | KEY.co
description_expanded: This house is perfect for your beach/Wild Dunes vacation. Easily could host three families. Largest Primary suite is on the first floor and completely secluded from the rest of the house. Very nice for privacy or anyone that likes to go to bed early or sleep in!! There is one other room with a private bath on the second floor. Two larger bedrooms that have private vanities and a jack-n-jill toilet/shower. The other two large bedrooms are combined. First you enter a massive king bedroom with large en-suite and through this bedroom you can get to the bunk room. We much appreciated the crib and high chair provided along with the toddler toys and family board games. The mattresses are all very comfortable; which is not always the case even with nicer rentals!! The enclosed porch was perfect to watch the ocean, and golfers while enjoying family time. The hot tub was easy to use and offers a great view. The kitchen has everything you will need to make any dinners you would like. The tankless
